# OpenFabric Studio

> Local AI studio for music production, singing and speaking voice cloning, and consistent characters for music videos and reels. Private, on your machine. Open source (MIT).

OpenFabric Studio is a desktop application that runs AI models locally — no cloud upload required for your creative work. Built for creators who want voice cloning, music generation, and character consistency without shipping data to a SaaS.

## Links

- Website: https://www.openfabric.studio/
- App (source): https://github.com/OpenFabric-Studio/openfabric-studio
- Website (source): https://github.com/OpenFabric-Studio/openfabric-studio-website
- Organization: https://github.com/OpenFabric-Studio
- License: MIT (see app and website repositories)

## Product pillars

- Voice — clone singing and speaking voices for covers, narration, and audiobooks; samples stay on disk
- Music — generate and shape tracks locally without subscription quotas
- Characters — consistent faces/looks across music videos and short-form reels
- Local-first — models and projects run on your hardware; offline-friendly
